hook: Most cuts STALL around week 8. Here's WHY 📉

title: YOUR CUT

slides.sub:
Same food, smaller deficit.
The maths nobody shows you.

title: 10 WEEKS IN
SAME BEDROOM
slides.note:
Two 12.5 kg dumbbells, a chair, a walking pad. No gym.
But the deeper you get, the harder it gets. Here's why.

title: YOUR BODY
GETS CHEAPER
slides.body:
Lose weight and you burn less.
A smaller body costs less to carry. You move less without noticing. And your body runs a bit more efficiently.
Nothing's broken. It's maths.

title: THE MATHS
WORKED EXAMPLE
slides.note: Rough example numbers. That 500 deficit has quietly become 150. You're not doing anything wrong. The target moved.

title: NEAT IS THE
HIDDEN ONE
slides.body: NEAT is everything that isn't training: walking, stairs, standing, fidgeting. On a cut it's the first thing to drop, and you don't feel it go. Know your real 7-day step average.

title: CHECK THE
SNEAKY STUFF
slides.body:
Weigh oils, sauces and spreads for 3 days. One tablespoon of olive oil is about 120 kcal.
And recalculate your maintenance every 4 to 5 kg you lose.

title: DO THIS
TODAY
slides.note: One change at a time, not both. Don't slash 500 more. Protein stays 1.6-2.2 g per kg, and keep lifting with control.

title: Cut gone
quiet?
story.body: Your 500 calorie deficit can shrink to 150 without you changing a thing. Swipe today's post.

caption:
Most cuts stall around week 8.
And it's not because you're lazy.

You lose weight, so you burn less.
A smaller body costs less to carry.

You also move less without noticing.
Fewer steps, less fidgeting, more sitting.

That's NEAT. It's the first thing to drop.
And you don't feel it go.

Example: 90 kg, eating 2,200.
Week 1 that's about a 500 calorie deficit.

5 kg later, same food,
it can be closer to 150.

So before you slash food,
check your real 7-day step average.

Set a floor, 8 to 10k a day.
That's exactly what a walking pad is for.

Weigh your oils and sauces for 3 days.
A tablespoon of olive oil is about 120 kcal.

Still flat after 2 to 3 weeks of averages?
Add 2,000 steps OR trim 100-150 kcal. Not both.

What's your daily step average right now?
Comment your number. No lying.

Send this to the mate who's "eating nothing" and not losing.

Comment SHRED and I'll send you my free Home Shred Blueprint.
Follow, subscribe and join my lives.
